title: Where do I report a lost item?

messages.content: Where do I report a lost item?

Based on verified PIT Jaunpur campus records:

• **Campus Lost and Found Reporting Protocol** (Lost & Found):
  # Campus Lost & Found Reporting Protocol ## Where to Report a Lost or Found Item - **Physical Office:** Student Welfare Desk (SWD), Ground Floor, Administrative Block A (opposite Room A-104), Prasad Institute of Technology, Jaunpur. - **Operating Timings:** Mo... [Source: Campus Lost and Found Reporting Protocol]

• **Campus Lost and Found Reporting Protocol** (Lost & Found):
  ## Protocol for Reporting a Lost Item 1. Visit the Student Welfare Desk or send an email with the subject line `[Lost Item] <Item Name> - <Date>`. 2. [Source: Campus Lost and Found Reporting Protocol]
